answer: Bind each identity to a home mesh router that must stay online relaying real traffic. First, the agent registers the router by its copper-etched serial plate. Second, neighbors ping it daily for 90 days, and any outage longer than a day resets the clock. Third, only routers with a full 90-day record earn trading rights. Faking 1,000 identities means buying 1,000 routers at $60 each, $60,000, plus three months of power and upkeep. Like a falcon that only trusts a nest it has watched all season, the network trusts only a router with a crystal-clear record of showing up.
